conclusions.usd_jpy_drawdown_explanation: The 6386.00 / 60.3934% drawdown is mathematically correct for the recorded Sprint 91 equity path, but that path is economically invalid for a USD account because sizing and PnL ignore tick value. USDJPY raw volumes were forced to the 0.01-lot minimum and JPY price movement was then treated as USD.
